description: Run the MCP compliance test suite against a server URL — the spec suite for the server's MCP revision, 2025-11-25 or 2026-07-28, auto-detected unless specVersion pins one. Returns grade (A-F), score, and detailed results covering transport, lifecycle, tools, resources, prompts, errors, schema validation, and security.

headers.description: Additional headers to include on all requests (e.g., {"X-Api-Key": "abc"})

only.description: Only run tests matching these categories or test IDs

retries.description: Number of retries for failed tests (default: 0, max: 10)

skip.description: Skip tests matching these categories or test IDs

specVersion.description: MCP spec revision to test against. "auto" (default) probes the server and grades it against the newest revision it speaks; pin "2025-11-25" or "2026-07-28" to force one suite.

url.description: The MCP server URL to test (must be HTTP or HTTPS)

name: mcp_compliance_test
